findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "helpdesk" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ticket_create, ticket_list, ticket_get, ticket_update, ticket_merge, ticket_connect_inbox, ticket_list_templates, ticket_get_settings, ticket_update_settings, ticket_report, account_set_owner_email, account_rename, account_get_limits, account_search, account_get_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_save_team, account_data_locations · Private data: ticket_list, ticket_reply, ticket_update, account_owner_link, account_search, account_set_brand, account_export_all, account_audit_log, account_find_person, account_export_person, account_erase_person, account_data_locations · Public sink: ticket_create, ticket_reply, ticket_merge, ticket_connect_inbox, ticket_update_settings, account_set_owner_email, account_rename, account_owner_link, account_get_limits, account_request_limit, account_emit_event, account_set_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_set_email_template, account_save_team, account_add_approval_rule, account_find_person, account_data_locations · Destructive: ticket_delete_template, account_balance, account_add_approval_rule.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
